interface.signature: def isScramble(self, S1: str, S2: str) -> bool

preconditions.description: The lengths of S1 and S2 must be equal.
The length of S1 must be between 1 and 31 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S1) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in S2)
preconditions.description: Both S1 and S2 must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: If S2 is a scrambled form of S1, the function returns True.
If S2 is not a scrambled form of S1, the function returns False.
